title: Influence functions on the ET-SoC-1 · ET-SoC-1
description: Exploratory desk analysis, estimates not measurements: which steps of large-scale influence-function work (training-data attribution) could suit the ET-SoC-1. None of the bill does; finding the most influential examples is cheap selection over expensive dense scores. Two narrow research items survive: scoring a static shard held in the chip's 72 MB of SRAM at a few queries per pass (6–9× less board energy per pass than an H100 reading HBM, no faster, and only while the card is kept busy), and an MNIST-sized pipeline run on one chip; plus a first experiment that would settle them.
